title: BlastProt Indiciator
description: A mod similar to crosshairaddons by Walksy which adds a display for when you have Blast Protection leggings on.
body:
It works with any type of leggings like leather, chainmail, iron, gold, diamond, netherite or even special ones from mods.
It shows a picture near your crosshair when you wear Blast Protection leggings.
The picture disappears when you take off the leggings.
You can move the picture, around the crosshair.
You can make it bigger or smaller.
There is a button you can press to turn it on and off.
If you have Cloth Config and Mod Menu you can change settings easily.
You don't need them to use BlastProtIndicator.
The only thing you need is Fabric API.
Your settings will be saved when you close the game via a config file.
